avoid_supplements.name: St. John's Wort
avoid_supplements.mechanism: CYP3A4 induction may reduce terbinafine plasma concentrations and efficacy
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid concurrent use; consider alternative mood support if needed

avoid_supplements.name: Echinacea
avoid_supplements.mechanism: May induce CYP3A4 and potentially reduce terbinafine levels
avoid_supplements.action: Use alternative immune support or separate dosing by 2+ hours

caution_supplements.name: Caffeine supplements
caution_supplements.mechanism: CYP1A2 competition may increase caffeine levels; terbinafine is a moderate CYP1A2 inhibitor
caution_supplements.action: Monitor for caffeine-related side effects; reduce caffeine intake if needed

caution_supplements.name: Ginseng
caution_supplements.mechanism: Potential minor CYP3A4 induction; may slightly reduce terbinafine efficacy
caution_supplements.action: Monitor clinical response; no dose adjustment typically required

avoid_foods.name: High-fat meals (concurrent dosing)
avoid_foods.mechanism: May increase terbinafine absorption variability; fat content affects bioavailability
avoid_foods.action: Take terbinafine consistently with or without food; avoid variable timing with fatty meals

caution_foods.name: Grapefruit/grapefruit juice
caution_foods.mechanism: CYP3A4 inhibition may increase terbinafine levels; clinically minor interaction
caution_foods.action: Limit consumption; monitor for increased side effects (headache, GI upset)

caution_foods.name: Caffeine-containing foods (coffee, tea, chocolate)
caution_foods.mechanism: CYP1A2 inhibition by terbinafine may increase caffeine accumulation
caution_foods.action: Moderate intake; monitor for jitteriness or insomnia

monitoring_notes: Terbinafine is a moderate CYP2D6 inhibitor that may increase levels of drugs metabolized by this pathway; monitor for hepatotoxicity and taste disturbances during therapy. Patient counseling should emphasize consistent meal timing and avoidance of enzyme-inducing supplements to maintain consistent antifungal efficacy.
